findings.source: BridgeExecutorBase._queue: _actionsSets[actionsSetId] = ActionsSet(targets, values, signatures, calldatas, withDelegatecalls, ...) (string[] and bytes[] copied to storage); getActionsSetById returns them
findings.issue: Copying string[]/bytes[] between memory and storage yields 53 nested implicit whiles (element loop, per-string slot loop, tail-clearing loop `while v`), so the one-line struct store of _queue fills about 300 lines and hides the three source loops among them.
findings.rule: Recognise the compiler's array-of-bytes storage copy (outer element loop, inner 32-byte slot copy, slot clean-up) and print it as `stor[...] = mem[...] (string[] copy)`; at least turn each inner word loop into a copy line (P7).

notes: Lido PolygonBridgeExecutor (solc 0.8.10). Source loops in BridgeExecutorBase, all shown as whiles: execute's action loop, cancel's loop (`while True` with the exit first), _queue's duplicate-action check loop in processMessageFromRoot (1294). Every other while is an implicit calldata decode, storage/memory copy of string[]/bytes[] or ABI encode (P7). processMessageFromRoot (603 lines) reviewed by structure.
summary: Faithful text whose three source loops are present, but the storage copies of string[]/bytes[] action fields expand into dozens of implicit nested loops.
